decision_text: The owner explicitly accepted the exact finished G4 Analytics Research family shown in the hash-bound r5 review board. Acceptance covers UI-AN-013 in all six required states, all six source-bound fixture actions, visible Result Trust and Focus/Explore character, responsive Web anchors 768/1024/1440/1920, and applicable pilot inheritance. It does not authorize production implementation, publication, deployment, mobile-specific design, another G4 family, G5, G6, or full WCAG conformance.
